Stage 1's data pull — every fn / slot / fn-slot / binding / list-item row in one branch-cached batch (versioned) or five vanilla queries. The whole pipeline is a pure transform over this snapshot; a per-context graph cache keeps hover-frequency layout requests from re-reading storage.

Synthesizes the per-fn 'arg view' rows the walkers consume: for each fn, its inherited slot surface with bindings overlaid closer-fn-wins, plus the ~:source-id~ chains that let an edge attribute an inherited slot to the ancestor that declared it. The slot/binding model's read-side counterpart.

Stage 2's orchestrator — dispatches the cycle-guarded ~process-*~ walkers over the expansion spec, then pipes the accumulated state through the post-processing transforms (optional/HOF badges, captured-edge migration, overlay dedup, strip facts). Produces the node/edge element lists the client draws verbatim.

* 4. emit-root-deep-frees!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: layout/emit-root-deep-frees!
:FILE: src/graphden/layout/builder_helpers.clj
:LINE: 932

After the walkers: the root card's DEEPER holes — a template's frees behind ancestor-bound refs — as ~:deepArg~ placeholders on the root itself, keyed by the inner slot but naming the root fn, so the ~+~ binder writes a closure-capture binding where the Run form lists the hole. The entry set is the SURFACE walk (~compile.renames/deep-free-ext-entries~): it stops at HOF boundaries, so a listener does not sprout every knob of the app it serves.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/layout/builder_helpers.clj::(defn emit-root-deep-frees!][src/graphden/layout/builder_helpers.clj:932]]

Stages 3+ — grid placement: roots at column zero, dependents right of their sources, rows packed to avoid overlap, plus the validation summary. Pixel geometry stays client-side (measured reflow off the real DOM); the server owns the grid topology.

* 6. annotate
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: layout/annotate
:FILE: src/graphden/layout/strip_facts.clj
:LINE: 60
:MINS: 2.3
:END:

The editor-facing tail: attach server-computed FACTS to each fn-node — the inherited return-type alias, the rule-owning base-fn (~registry/rule-owner-of~), and the transitive branch-local seed (~branch-local/branch-local-seed~). These replaced three hand-written client mirrors of the same walks; the client renders facts, it doesn't re-derive them.
